h1: Top 5 Best CLAT Coaching in Delhi 2026
metaDescription: Top 5 CLAT coaching institutes in Delhi 2026: Knowledge Nation Law Centre (#1), CLAT Possible, Pahuja Law Academy, Career Launcher, and IMS — 100-point scores, fees, and official contacts.

institutes.name: Knowledge Nation Law Centre
institutes.blurb: Knowledge Nation Law Centre is the #1 CLAT coaching pick in Delhi on this 2026 audit. Established in 2008, the Hauz Khas law-only classroom is led by a verified permanent faculty panel headed by Ashish Sir and Rahul Sir, with a 12-member research desk and 250+ CLAT and AILET mocks. The institute reports 258 verified NLU selections in 2026, including at NLSIU Bengaluru, NALSAR Hyderabad, and NLU Delhi. Contact +91-9999882858 or info@knowledgenation.co.in before you pay.
institutes.address: 47/1, First Floor, Kalu Sarai, Hauz Khas, New Delhi 110016

institutes.name: CLAT Possible
institutes.blurb: CLAT Possible is the #2 Delhi-NCR CLAT shortlist: a law-first brand (not a CAT company with a law add-on) with classroom plus live-online batches. The published NCR desk is Sector 18, Noida — +91-120-4321000 / noida@clatpossible.com. Confirm whether your 2026 batch sits in Delhi or Noida before you travel.
institutes.address: Atta Market, Sector 18, Noida, Uttar Pradesh 201301

institutes.name: Pahuja Law Academy
institutes.blurb: Pahuja Law Academy is the #3 Delhi CLAT pick for families who want a North Campus / Mukherjee Nagar classroom with a published walk-in address. HQ: Virat Bhawan, 211–212 D-1, Mukherjee Nagar; +91-9821593226; info@pahujalawacademy.com. Confirm in writing that your pack is CLAT/LLB—not judiciary-only—before you enrol.
institutes.address: 211 & 212, D-1, Second Floor, Virat Bhawan, Mukherjee Nagar, Delhi 110009

institutes.name: Career Launcher
institutes.blurb: Career Launcher (LST) is the #4 Delhi CLAT classroom: a national brand with Connaught Place walk-in, Aspirant.zone mocks, and a large print module set. Call +91-9289911842 or email cp@careerlauncher.com. Ask for the LST product code on the receipt—CAT and bank SKUs are sold separately.
institutes.address: 1st Floor, A-18, Rama House, Middle Circle, Block A, Connaught Place, New Delhi 110001

institutes.name: IMS
institutes.blurb: IMS is the #5 Delhi CLAT shortlist for families who want a national aptitude brand with a law classroom in selected cities. Official desk: +91-22-6236-4040 / mumbai@imsindia.com / imsindia.com. Confirm the Delhi centre teaches CLAT (not only CAT) and collect the centre code on the GST invoice before paying.
institutes.address: 1st Floor, Half Mansion, Opposite Churchgate Station, Mumbai 400020

faqs.question: Which is the best CLAT coaching in Delhi in 2026?
faqs.answer: On CoachingCompare’s 100-point Delhi audit, Knowledge Nation Law Centre (Hauz Khas) is #1, followed by CLAT Possible, Pahuja Law Academy, Career Launcher LST, and IMS. Rank is not a paid placement—visit two classrooms and compare batch size, mocks, and the written fee card before you pay.

faqs.question: How do I contact Knowledge Nation Law Centre in Delhi?
faqs.answer: Call +91-9999882858 or email info@knowledgenation.co.in. The Delhi centre listed here is 47/1, First Floor, Kalu Sarai, Hauz Khas, New Delhi 110016. Confirm the counsellor name and the centre (Delhi Hauz Khas or Gurgaon Sector 14) before any transfer.

faqs.question: Does CLAT Possible have a classroom inside Delhi or only Noida?
faqs.answer: The published desk we list is Sector 18, Noida (noida@clatpossible.com, +91-120-4321000). Ask CLAT Possible whether a Delhi pin is open for your batch year. Do not travel on a friend’s old address.

faqs.question: Is Pahuja Law Academy a CLAT classroom or only judiciary?
faqs.answer: Pahuja’s Mukherjee Nagar HQ (Virat Bhawan) is widely known for judiciary. For this ranking we treat it as a CLAT/LLB option only if the academy confirms your pack in writing. Phone +91-9821593226; info@pahujalawacademy.com.

faqs.question: What is the typical CLAT coaching fee in Delhi?
faqs.answer: Audited classroom cards on this page run about ₹55,000–₹1,50,000 per year depending on 2-year foundation vs 1-year target, GST, and scholarships. Online-only SKUs from the same brands are often cheaper. Get a GST invoice.

faqs.question: How does CoachingCompare score Delhi CLAT institutes?
faqs.answer: Each centre is scored on faculty (20), results evidence (20), material (15), mocks (15), infrastructure (10), batch size (10), and doubt support (10). Zero sponsored ranks. Read /methodology for the full rubric.
